work.objective: Replace the screenshot-visible POC composer chrome with an Ink-parity OpenTUI composer: remove the duplicate outer full border, preserve the prompt's single top rule and bottom edge, restore the canonical placeholder, and remove the non-Ink always-ready instruction line.
context: Current backend.tsx wraps OpenTuiInputPrompt in a full single border while input-prompt.tsx renders its own top and bottom rules, producing the oversized double-frame shown by the user.
Ink BaseTextInput/InputPrompt uses one full-width top rule plus the prompt bottom edge and canonical placeholder; it does not show the permanent 'ready · click cards...' sentence.
This is the only parallel leaf allowed to edit backend.tsx; header/messages/theme leaves avoid that file.
constraints: Use repository-relative paths for every operation.
Only modify the four allowlisted composer files; no Ink, dependency, lockfile, Marshal-state, commit, push, publication, network or subagent changes.
Remove backend's outer bordered composer box and placeholder override; OpenTuiInputPrompt remains the sole owner of composer chrome.
Match Ink spacing and width at 80 and 120 columns using pure layout helpers with exact tests; retain focus colors and Backspace behavior.
Remove the permanent ready/click/drag/wheel instruction line. Do not replace it with another always-on status sentence.
Preserve streaming/loading behavior except for layout placement; do not redesign header, messages, theme or dialogs.
Worker checks may use targeted/OpenTUI vitest, CLI typecheck/build and git diff --check only; native Bun PTY belongs to verifier.
Do not mutate the Git index or read prior Marshal run artifacts/worktrees.
